funding.raw: **A bounty of** $420.00 **has been created by** [AsciiWolf](https://github.com/AsciiWolf) **on BountyHub** for this issue.

admission.agent_reason: Funded bounty: the accepted bounty platform bot bountyhub-bot posted a committed $420 US bounty created by repository contributor AsciiWolf for this issue, so the figure is written by a bounty platform bot enumerated in the domain rules. Scope is bounded to a single deliverable feature (basic TX support: AM/SSB/NFM modulators, a GUI/keyboard transmit trigger, Hamlib rigctl, and TX gain controls). Repository intent: gqrx-sdr/gqrx is the real Gqrx SDR receiver and merges outside work (e.g. argilo's PR #1473 merged 2026-10-27). code_evidence src/applications/gqrx/mainwindow.cpp is the product source file that wires the demodulator/GUI selection and is where the TX button, modulator selection, and TX gain controls would be added; the quoted line connects the demod selector slot in that file.
admission.scope_quote: Good start could be adding some basic AM/SSB and NFM modulators. Gqrx is based on GNU Radio and there are already GNU Radio blocks for this. Filters and other things can be shared with the RX part.
